bounded_question: Can a typographic/editorial grammar establish a materially distinctive Kymaean shared-brand mechanism independent of other identity carriers while surviving the frozen dual-context accessibility/reflow contract?
controlled_inputs: Frozen 24-specimen system-ui text-only family pack with WEB/APP and WIDE/320 conditions plus accessibility stress.

local_result.summary: TYP-01 strong-independence closed before blinded scoring with zero surviving scored families because every F1-F4 family violated at least one frozen 320px/200%-resize horizontal-overflow accessibility floor.

judgment.design_sol_view: No subjective family judgment was admitted after the hard preflight failure.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: No Director taste selection was required because the frozen conjunctive method closed mechanically at accessibility preflight.

mechanical: all four scored families failed at least one frozen accessibility condition
accessibility: binding failure: horizontal overflow at 320px under 200% text resize

constrains: future typography/editorial research must be a genuinely new authorized program rather than a TYP-01 reroll
must_not_be_confused_with: a claim that typography as a design axis is impossible

known_integration_sensitivities: Whole-app synthesis must explicitly show typography as an unresolved system gap rather than silently treating historical/O3/fixture typography as final.
Future composition views may use neutral/temporary typography only when clearly labeled as a carrier, not as a packet-selected identity mechanism.
explicit_non_authority: This closure does not prove typography cannot contribute to Kymaean identity.
It does not select a typeface or final typographic system.
It does not authorize a TYP-01 family repair after result visibility.
lawful_reentry_triggers: new integration evidence demonstrating a separately bounded typography question
changed governing accessibility/design contract with explicit new-program authority

director_review_surface.what_to_review: No Director visual choice remains; packet preserves a mechanical zero-survivor closure and an unresolved future typography gap.
